name: auditing-aml-transactions
description: Performs and reviews transaction-level BSA/AML testing for U.S. banks, money services businesses and broker-dealers: alert and case review and QA sampling, lookbacks, transaction-level testing of monitoring thresholds and below-the-line sampling, structuring and CTR aggregation across branches and linked accounts, 314(a) match follow-up, SAR decisioning support, SAR timeliness, SAR narrative drafting and SAR QA sampling, and reviewer independence. Applies the SAR threshold and clock for the actual institution type (31 C.F.R. 1020.320; 1022.320 with $2,000 and no extension for MSBs), starts the clock at determination, not the alert, treats continuing-activity review and no-SAR documentation as elections under the October 2025 SAR FAQs, and sizes samples to the conclusion drawn. Declines to suppress, reclassify or close alerts to avoid filing, or to tip off a customer. Routes AML program and policy design to aml-compliance-program. Drafts for BSA/AML officer review.
